content.text: Read requirements.txt. In separate tool calls, create fibonacci.js and execute it with node fibonacci.js. Compute Fibonacci with F(0)=0 and F(1)=1. Export fibonacci(n) using module.exports.fibonacci, compute values rather than hard-coding them, and print FIBONACCI_20=<computed number> when the program runs. Inspect the actual execution output, then report the 20th Fibonacci number and the command you ran. Work only in this directory. Do not read other directories, access credentials, use network tools, or spawn subagents.

[requirements.txt#3D7F]
1:Use Node.js and CommonJS. F(0)=0; F(1)=1. Implement and export fibonacci(n), compute F(20), and print FIBONACCI_20=<computed number>.

```bash
node fibonacci.js
```

FIBONACCI_20=6765
